Contact CSV Deduplicator

Merge and clean duplicate CRM contacts using email and international phone numbers. Zero server uploads — all processing happens directly in your browser.

What it does

Identifies and removes duplicate customer or contact rows in CSV exports by normalizing email casing and stripping non-digit phone formatting. Preserves the first primary contact record while cleaning up duplicate entries caused by multiple marketing imports or CRM merges.

How to use

  1. Drop your CRM or address book CSV file into the contact deduplicator drop area.
  2. The tool automatically detects email and phone number columns across your dataset.
  3. Review the summary displaying total unique contacts preserved and duplicate rows removed.
  4. Download the cleaned, deduplicated CSV file ready for CRM import or email marketing.

Limits & Considerations

Matches records using normalized email strings and cleaned phone digits. Does not perform fuzzy phonetic name matching or nickname deduplication.

Privacy & Security

Customer names, phone numbers, and emails are processed solely in local browser memory. Zero risk of CRM data leaks or privacy violations.
